status: All four seasons have already been seen; no new-season game downloads permitted.

roster.pool: All regular-season fixtures dated <= common cutoff; sort date then game ID. Sample an entire appeared-player list and its official starter/position assignment uniformly with replacement for each team and future fixture. Never sample players independently.
roster.rng: makeRng((seed XOR 0x9B137AC1) + imul(scheduleIndex+1,7919) + team-side index); same sampled pool entry across v3/v4/seg/naive.
roster.minutes: Frozen cutoff seasonMinutesPerGame, normalized to240 with48 cap by thirdLineup; no post observed seconds. Read training boxes only for active identities/starters and naive PM. Actual future active identities/starters are conditional inputs. Retain past players traded away using unchanged cutoff cards joined by player ID.
roster.pairing: Identical frozen card/options/calendar/post fixtures/game seed; only active identity/starter/position inputs differ. Both teams changed. Actual runs reused only after exact score parity verification.

delta.definition: Per-game signed margin(actual)-margin(training-roster counterfactual), average over each team future games; report20seed SD/sqrt20 for each team and population team SD of20seed means.
delta.seg: Frozen forward role Poisson model: eta=intercept+sum(normalized target minutes/240 * (priorOffense+offenseResidual)) on offense and analogous full defenseAllowed on opponent. exp(clamp(eta,-8,8)). Difference of both offensive PPPs times training-only pooled paired possessions proxy/G. Evaluate actual vs sampled training rosters, using v3 target minutes; no future stints/seconds or B1 double counting. Missing player coefficient uses mean training-minute-weighted role prior and zero residual, with explicit counts.
delta.naive: For each player, r=sum(training PLUS_MINUS across teams)/sum(training MIN); unseen/zero minutes r=0. Own neutral margin level=sum(targetMinutes*r)/5 (5 avoids counting identical shared court margin five times). Game predicted margin=own level-opponent level. Delta is actual minus counterfactual same fixtures/seed, v3 normalized target minutes. No smoothing, clipping, team offset, estimated shrinkage or post PM.

diagnostics.error: observed centered post net minus simple/simplecal centered forecast; positive slope means delta predicts omitted improvement.
quantities: error/delta correlation and centered OLS slope
diagnostics.deterministic: All deltas inherit training-roster Monte Carlo sampling; SE includes roster sample variability and, for sim, game randomness.

fit.model: center within season and K; y=a(K)*x+b*delta. a has3 K-specific global coefficients; one b shared across all3 K. Train on3 other seasons, equal season/K/team weights, unpenalized least squares, no intercept/clipping. Solve via residualizing delta and y against x within each K; rank tolerance1e-10. Refit entire LOSO on bootstrap draws. Fixed-b1 version refits a(K) with b=1.
fit.baselines: Frozen simple and simplecal(ms from eighth C prereg); min reselected per metric/bootstrap draw, evaluation only.

wins.off: All hybrid net forecasts use a reference logistic link p=sigmoid(net/T), with T=sqrt(3)/pi times mean frozen v3 simulation residualSD of3 other seasons at that K. This is an explicit reference mapping, not unchanged engine wins. Simple off retains frozen Pythagorean wins.
wins.on: One positive logistic slope beta per K/model, binomial MLE on3 other seasons. Training forecasts for this link are inner leave-one-season (fit a,b on remaining2), no held-out season result is used. Bound beta to[0.025,0.5] (temperature2..40); Newton maximum12 steps, tolerance1e-8. Apply postGames*sigmoid(beta*predicted net). Simple on uses its training-net feature and same other-season link. Refit in joint bootstrap.
wins.purpose: wins comparison exploratory, no wins gate and no per-team probability offsets.

bootstrap.unit: Shared30 franchise draws and20 seed draws across all seasons/K/models; season equal weighting; seed ensemble averages before metrics; per-season centering recomputed using drawn franchise weights.
bootstrap.RMSE: sqrt(mean(equal-season MSE)); paired comparisons reselect min(simple,simplecal) each draw; refit a,b and link.
bootstrap.signal: Same franchise+seed draws for signal slopes/correlations; degenerate values null.

gate.sameSign: All4 fitted LOSO b strictly positive or all strictly negative, zero fails.
gate.gain: Pooled four-season LOSO netRMSE delta vs min(simple,simplecal)<0 in at least2 K.
gate.naive: Candidate fitted-b pooled netRMSE no larger than fitted-b naive on at least2 K satisfying gain AND pooled equal-weight3K RMSE no larger than naive. Also report candidate-naive joint interval; passing point rule is permission for later blind test, not verified gain.
gate.fixedB: b=1 is a sensitivity control, not an alternative rescue gate.
gate.failure: If no eligible delta passes all conditions, stop: 現有球員卡無法在簡單對照之上提供可驗證的增量. Do not download blind game data.

power.method: Planning-only normal approximation using observed paired-bootstrap SE, effect0.15/0.40 and two-sided95% threshold; one-season SE summarized by K range, three-season scenarios independent1/sqrt3 and franchise-correlated SE held unchanged. Also empirical bootstrap shift approximation. No new-season outcomes inspected.

feasibility: Metadata/documentation/HTTP headers only for2021-22/2018-19/2017-18; do not GET new-season boxes/PBP/tracking payloads or schedule outcomes. Historical schema compatibility may remain unverified.
